part.text:
Fixed. The regression was that `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor` called `injector.getInstance(IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider.class)` for non-MiddleManager nodes, but Peons (which run via `CliPeon`, not `CliIndexer`) have no such binding, causing Guice injection to fail.

Changes in `server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/metrics/WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor.java`:
- Use `injector.getExistingBinding(Key.get(IndexerTaskCountStatsProvider.class))` instead of `getInstance`, so the provider is `null` when unbound (server/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/server/metrics/WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitor.java:58)
- Skip the indexer-metrics branch of `doMonitor` when the provider is absent

Verified: `WorkerTaskCountStatsMonitorTest` (including `testMonitorWithPeon`), `MetricsModuleTest`, `TaskCountStatsMonitorTest`, `TaskSlotCountStatsMonitorTest` all pass.
